entities.summary: Jillian Pauline Saulnier is a Canadian ice hockey player who is a forward for the Boston Fleet of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). She is a two-time Olympian for Canada, winning a gold medal in 2022 and a silver medal in 2018.
